editorial:
Imagine a small island where everything goes wrong because of a military mistake. You get a wild story about a dead terrorist and a chemical leak that turns people into monsters. It feels like a classic B-movie where the goal is just to have a good time with lots of gore and chaos. You will follow a group of survivors trying to make it out alive while the world around them falls apart. It has that old-school 80s grit that makes it feel like a real ride, and it does not take itself too seriously.

While the acting is a bit stiff and the plot has some holes, the special effects are what really make this one special. If you love seeing gross makeup and crazy zombie fights, you will be happy. It is not a masterpiece, but it is a blast for a movie night with friends. It is a perfect pick for anyone who misses the days of practical effects and loud action.
endingExplained: As the chaos peaks, the survivors try to escape the island. Most of the characters get eaten or killed by the zombie hordes in a bloody mess. You see the military try to contain the outbreak, but it is mostly too late. The movie ends with the realization that the virus is out there and the world is in big trouble. It wraps up with a dark feeling, leaving you wondering how many other places got infected.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old school gore and B-movies.
